@@ -196,6 +196,18 @@ $ ~> | $ | {

An object opens a scope

When the value is an object, that object becomes the context for the body.

+ +

There is no if — the shape decides

+
+

+ Mustache has no conditionals. {t("{{#admin}}")} is not an + if — it is a section on the key admin, shown when + admin is truthy/present and hidden otherwise. There is no else if + and no helper; a key that's missing simply hides its block (banned below). + This is the one thing the Handlebars examples got wrong. +

+
